c74object.name: mc.ear.record~
c74object.digest: Record an ADM file (BW64 with ADM metadata): the multichannel input is the objects' audio, one channel per object (as fed to mc.ear.objects~), and the object metadata is sent to this object in the same format as to mc.ear.objects~ (setvalue N parameter, applyvalues, lists) while it records
c74object.description: Record an ADM file (BW64 with ADM metadata): the multichannel input is the objects' audio, one channel per object (as fed to mc.ear.objects~), and the object metadata is sent to this object in the same format as to mc.ear.objects~ (setvalue N parameter, applyvalues, lists) while it records. Every change is written as an audioBlockFormat timed by the audio itself, with the ramp in force as its interpolation, so audio and metadata cannot drift apart. 'open path' names the file, 'start' (or 1) records from the current parameters, 'stop' (or 0) finishes the file and reports it on the outlet. The number of channels written is the chans attribute: extra input channels are ignored, missing ones are silent. Files over 4 GB are written as RF64.

method.name: anything
method.digest: Object metadata: any parameter sent as a message applies to all objects
method.description: Object metadata: any parameter sent as a message applies to all objects.

method.name: applyvalues
method.digest: Object metadata: 'applyvalues parameter v1 v2 v3 ...' spreads values over the objects
method.description: Object metadata: 'applyvalues parameter v1 v2 v3 ...' spreads values over the objects.

method.name: bitdepth
method.description: Set the bitdepth attribute. Bit depth of the audio written: 16, 24 or 32 (integer PCM). Takes effect at the next 'start'.

method.name: chans
method.description: Set the chans attribute. Number of objects recorded: the channels of the file written, one per input channel (extra input channels are ignored, missing ones are silent). Takes effect at the next 'start'.

method.name: clear
method.digest: Reset every object's parameters and ramp (not while recording)
method.description: Reset every object's parameters and ramp (not while recording).

method.name: list
method.digest: Object metadata: a list sets the position of all objects
method.description: Object metadata: a list sets the position of all objects.

method.name: name
method.digest: Name an object in the file: 'name N symbol' (N is 1-based)
method.description: Name an object in the file: 'name N symbol' (N is 1-based).

method.name: open
method.digest: Name the file to record: 'open path' (an absolute path, or relative to the Max search path)
method.description: Name the file to record: 'open path' (an absolute path, or relative to the Max search path).

method.name: position
method.digest: Report the recording's length so far in milliseconds on the outlet
method.description: Report the recording's length so far in milliseconds on the outlet.

method.name: programmename
method.description: Set the programmename attribute. Name of the audioProgramme written.

method.name: ramp
method.description: Set the ramp attribute. Default interpolation time in milliseconds written for the changes, as the renderer's ramp attribute; 'setvalue N ramp ms' overrides it per object (a negative value returns to it).

method.name: setvalue
method.digest: Object metadata, in the mc.ear.objects~ format: 'setvalue N parameter values...' (N is 1-based; 0 sets all objects)
method.description: Object metadata, in the mc.ear.objects~ format: 'setvalue N parameter values...' (N is 1-based; 0 sets all objects). Parameters: azimuth elevation distance x y z cartesian position width height depth gain diffuse channellock channellock_distance divergence divergence_range screenref screenedgelock_h screenedgelock_v, and ramp (the interpolation time written for the next changes of that object; negative returns to the ramp attribute). While recording, a change becomes a block at the audio's current time.

method.name: start
method.digest: Start recording the file named by 'open' (or 'start path'): the audio is written from now, the objects' current parameters become their first blocks
method.description: Start recording the file named by 'open' (or 'start path'): the audio is written from now, the objects' current parameters become their first blocks. Reports 'recording path' on the outlet.

method.name: stop
method.digest: Stop recording: the file is finished with the captured metadata and reported as 'written path objects length-ms' on the outlet (or 'failed path')
method.description: Stop recording: the file is finished with the captured metadata and reported as 'written path objects length-ms' on the outlet (or 'failed path').

attribute.name: bitdepth
attribute.digest: Bit depth of the audio written: 16, 24 or 32 (integer PCM)
attribute.description: Bit depth of the audio written: 16, 24 or 32 (integer PCM). Takes effect at the next 'start'. Default: 24.

attribute.name: chans
attribute.digest: Number of objects recorded: the channels of the file written, one per input channel (extra input channels are ignored, missing ones are silent)
attribute.description: Number of objects recorded: the channels of the file written, one per input channel (extra input channels are ignored, missing ones are silent). Takes effect at the next 'start'. Default: 16.

attribute.name: programmename
attribute.description: Name of the audioProgramme written. Default: libear-max.

attribute.name: ramp
attribute.digest: Default interpolation time in milliseconds written for the changes, as the renderer's ramp attribute; 'setvalue N ramp ms' overrides it per object (a negative value returns to it)
attribute.description: Default interpolation time in milliseconds written for the changes, as the renderer's ramp attribute; 'setvalue N ramp ms' overrides it per object (a negative value returns to it). Default: 10.
